import os,re,itertools
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
from collections import Counter
def feats(I,O):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    c=Counter(x for r in I for x in r)
    spe=min(c,key=c.get); bg=max(c,key=c.get)
    e=[(r,cc) for r in range(H) for cc in range(W) if I[r][cc]==spe]
    Eset=set(e)
    F=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for cc in range(W):
            if (r,cc) in Eset: continue
            dm=[abs(r-a)+abs(cc-b) for a,b in e]
            dc=[max(abs(r-a),abs(cc-b)) for a,b in e]
            od=sum(x%2 for x in dm)   # odd manh distances count
            ed=sum(x%2 for x in dc)   # odd cheb distances count
            F.append(((r,cc),(r,cc) in {(a,b) for a,b in [(rr,rc) for rr in range(H) for rc in range(W) if O[rr][rc]!=bg]}, len(dm), len(dc), sum(x%2 for x in dm), sum(x%2 for x in dc)))
    return e,F
for n in [1,2,3]:
    I=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    e,F=feats(I,O)
    print('demo',n)
    for f_ in sorted(F,key=lambda x:str(x[2]+x[3])):
        col,f2,dm,dc,om,oe=f_
        print('  ',f2,' manh-od=',om,' cheb-od=',oe,' ndist',dm[0],dc[0], '|',dm)

import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])   # this instance's own log: the folder keeps every earlier one's
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
